beats.text: At eight percent, one number tells you when your money doubles: seventy-two divided by eight — about nine years.
beats.spoken: At eight percent, one number tells you when your money doubles: seventy-two divided by eight — about nine years.

beats.text: At six percent, twelve years. At twelve percent, six. At three percent, twenty-four.
beats.spoken: At six percent, twelve years. At twelve percent, six. At three percent, twenty-four.

beats.text: The exact answer at eight percent is nine years and two days.
beats.spoken: The exact answer at eight percent is nine years and two days.

beats.text: It is not a banker's superstition. It is a logarithm. So why does seventy-two work — and what is a logarithm, really?
